title: Virtual Assistant Skills
description: For school leavers who are organised and want to support busy business owners online. You will learn the everyday work of a virtual assistant – email, calendars, Google Workspace, data entry, research and simple tools like Trello and Canva – and how to find your first clients.
outcomes: Explain what virtual assistants do and which services you can offer
Organise an inbox and manage a calendar using Gmail and Google Calendar
Schedule meetings correctly across time zones
Do accurate data entry and online research in Google Sheets and Docs
Use Trello and Canva for simple tasks clients often need
Communicate professionally and find your first VA clients
